title: Masked diffusion as random sequential adsorption: an exactly solvable model for parallel decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.07845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion models generate text by reversing a stochastic masking process. Unlike autoregressive LLMs, which generate text one token at a time, they can reveal many tokens in parallel, at the price of an error, since tokens revealed together are drawn independently. We show that this trade-off maps onto the statistical physics of driven many-particle systems. (i) For any data, the error of parallel generation is the entropy production of the generation process relative to the reversed masking process. (ii) For Markov data, generation is a random sequential adsorption process with labelled gaps, which we solve exactly for any number of steps. (iii) For many steps, the error becomes the dissipation of a slowly driven system: the unmasking schedule plays the role of the driving protocol, the number of steps that of its duration, and the error is set by a thermodynamic metric that we obtain in closed form from the mutual information

translated_title: 掩码扩散作为随机序贯吸附：一个精确可解的并行解码模型
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型通过逆转一个随机掩码过程来生成文本。与每次生成一个token的自回归大语言模型不同，它们可以并行揭示多个token，但代价是引入误差，因为同时揭示的token是彼此独立抽取的。我们证明这种权衡可以映射到驱动多粒子系统的统计物理中。(i) 对于任意数据，并行生成的误差等于生成过程相对于逆转掩码过程的熵产生。(ii) 对于马尔可夫数据，生成过程是一个带标记间隙的随机序贯吸附过程，我们对其任意步数均给出了精确解。(iii) 对于多步情况，误差变为缓慢驱动系统的耗散：去掩码调度扮演驱动协议的角色，步数扮演其持续时间的角色，而误差由一个热力学度规决定，我们从互信息中以闭式形式求得了该度规。
tldr: 该论文将掩码扩散模型并行解码的误差与驱动多粒子系统的熵产生和耗散联系起来，并把马尔可夫数据下的生成精确等价为一个可严格求解的随机序贯吸附过程，从而建立了并行解码的首个精确可解理论模型。
en_tdlr: This paper maps the error of parallel decoding in masked diffusion models onto the entropy production and dissipation of driven many-particle systems, and exactly solves generation of Markov data as a random sequential adsorption process.
